from pathlib import Path
programs=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1790689854/attempts/71aa0823e1d7415ab0ea5a5c0e56a9c6/system/state/workspace/programs')
programs.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
source='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # Full uniform non-background rows/columns mark the panel boundaries.
    bg = max(set(v for row in grid for v in row), key=lambda v: sum(row.count(v) for row in grid))
    hr = [r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1 and row[0] != bg]
    vc = [c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1 and grid[0][c] != bg]
    r_edges = [-1] + hr + [h]
    c_edges = [-1] + vc + [w]
    row_spans = [(r_edges[i] + 1, r_edges[i+1]) for i in range(len(r_edges)-1)]
    col_spans = [(c_edges[i] + 1, c_edges[i+1]) for i in range(len(c_edges)-1)]
    panels = []
    for r0, r1 in row_spans:
        for c0, c1 in col_spans:
            panel = [row[c0:c1] for row in grid[r0:r1]]
            if panel and panel[0] and (r1-r0) > 0 and (c1-c0) > 0:
                panels.append((r0, r1, c0, c1, panel))
    # The single populated panel is the pattern to tile throughout the grid.
    nonempty = [(r0, r1, c0, c1, p) for r0, r1, c0, c1, p in panels if any(x != bg for row in p for x in row)]
    if not nonempty:
        return [row[:] for row in grid]
    sr0, sr1, sc0, sc1, pattern = nonempty[0]
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r0, r1, c0, c1, _ in panels:
        if r1-r0 == len(pattern) and c1-c0 == len(pattern[0]):
            for dr in range(r1-r0):
                out[r0+dr][c0:c1] = pattern[dr][:]
    return out
'''
